mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.site_announcement (id, type, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO public.site_announcement_translations (announcement_id, locale, title, message) VALUES (#{announcementId}, #{locale}, #{title}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.type, a.status, a.created_at, t.announcement_id, t.locale, t.title, t.message FROM public.site_announcement a LEFT JOIN public.site_announcement_translations t ON a.id = t.announcement_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.type, a.status, a.created_at, t.announcement_id, t.locale, t.title, t.message FROM ( SELECT id, type, status, created_at FROM public.site_announcement ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) a LEFT JOIN public.site_announcement_translations t ON a.id = t.announcement_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.type, a.status, a.created_at, t.announcement_id, t.locale, t.title, t.message FROM public.site_announcement a INNER JOIN public.site_announcement_translations t ON a.id = t.announcement_id WHERE a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.locale = #{locale} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
